SC.title: SC applicant
notes: NSFDC currently serves Scheduled Caste beneficiaries.
Current NSFDC FAQ states annual family income for loan beneficiaries must not exceed ₹5 lakh.
A valid caste certificate issued by the competent authority is required.
documents: Cost estimates or quotations where applicable
Bank/account details as required by the lender

ST.title: ST applicant
notes: NSFDC now functions exclusively for Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. ST applicants should be routed to the appropriate Scheduled Tribes finance/development channel instead of NSFDC.
alternatives: Check NSTFDC / the relevant State ST Development Corporation and its current channel partners.

OBC.title: OBC applicant
notes: OBC applicants are not the target group of NSFDC. Gram Mitra should route them to the appropriate OBC finance/development channel rather than presenting NSFDC as eligible.
documents: Valid OBC certificate where the alternate scheme requires it
alternatives: Check NBCFDC and the relevant State Backward Classes Development Corporation for current schemes and channel partners.

GENERAL.title: General category applicant
notes: The two NSFDC schemes configured here are targeted to Scheduled Caste beneficiaries. General-category applicants should be shown alternative mainstream or sector-specific schemes instead of being marked eligible for NSFDC.
documents: Income proof if required by the alternate scheme
alternatives: Explore other government or bank MSME/enterprise schemes that match the business and applicant profile.

SC: Concessional beneficiary interest rates are built into MFS/TLS when the applicant is eligible and the loan is sanctioned under the scheme.
Women beneficiaries: NSFDC currently states a 40% targeted allocation of funds under Term Loan and Micro Finance Schemes for women beneficiaries; this is not an automatic interest-rate discount.
WOMAN: For an eligible SC woman, the current NSFDC FAQ states a 40% targeted allocation of funds under Term Loan and Micro Finance Schemes for women beneficiaries.
This should be displayed as a targeted-allocation benefit, not as an automatic rate concession.
PWD: No universal NSFDC interest concession for disability is asserted here. Gram Mitra should check the applicant's other applicable corporation/state scheme before promising a concession.
If a disability-specific scheme is selected, require the relevant disability certificate and verify the current scheme rules.
SENIOR: No universal NSFDC senior-citizen concession is asserted here. Any age-based benefit must be verified against the selected lender or alternate scheme.

document_guidance.caste_certificate: If missing, do not substitute an invented document. Guide the user to obtain/reissue the certificate from the competent authority or confirm with the channelizing agency whether a digitally issued/electronic certificate is accepted.
document_guidance.income_proof: If missing, guide the user to obtain the current income certificate/proof accepted by the relevant authority or lender. Acceptance of alternatives is lender-specific.
document_guidance.kyc: If a particular KYC document is unavailable, show the lender's current accepted KYC list instead of assuming a substitute.
document_guidance.business_documents: Project report, quotations, licenses/registrations and other business documents depend on the activity and lender. Mark them as conditional rather than universally mandatory.
